name: provider-imagegen
description: Generate and edit raster images through the active Codex provider's OpenAI-compatible Images API.

interface.shortDescription: Generate or edit images through the active provider CLI.
interface.longDescription: A CLI-only image workflow that reads the active provider credential cache populated by Codex Sync, calls its OpenAI-compatible Images endpoint, saves local raster files, and verifies genuine PNG transparency when requested.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image with the active provider CLI.
Edit this image with the active provider CLI.
